nb_queried.name: NB-5 Property & Real Estate (curated, ledger ground-truth source)

nb_query: What is the current 2026 status of the Bali construction moratorium? Does the formal 2026 ban apply to the four Sarbagita regencies (Denpasar, Badung, Gianyar, Tabanan), or a different set of districts? Was the 'Sarbagita' Sept-2024 proposal adopted or cancelled/reversed? Which districts does the formal 2026 ban actually cover, and which are EXCLUDED?
ledger_current_fact_candidate: INVERTED: the 2026 formal ban covers 6 LESS-developed districts (Tabanan, Jembrana, Buleleng, Bangli, Karangasem, Klungkung) and EXCLUDES the tourist core (Badung/Gianyar/Denpasar). A separate province-wide ban applies only to agricultural-land conversion. 'Sarbagita' was the cancelled Sept-2024 proposal.
nb_citation_verbatim: the original September 2024 proposal targeted the opposite geography — the Sarbagita area (Denpasar, Badung, Gianyar, Tabanan) ... The actual 2026 policy reversed this focus, protecting less-developed districts instead. ... [Jan 9-17 2025] Governor Koster explicitly cancels moratorium. ... The formal 6-district construction ban covers Tabanan, Jembrana, Buleleng, Bangli, Karangasem, and Klungkung — notably excluding the main tourist zones of Badung, Gianyar, and Denpasar. Separately, a province-wide ban on converting productive agricultural land into commercial developments applies everywhere.
verdict_rationale: Live NB-5 confirms the inversion verbatim with a dated event table: Sarbagita = cancelled Sept-2024 proposal (Koster cancelled Jan 2025); actual 2026 formal ban = 6 less-developed districts, tourist core EXCLUDED; separate province-wide agricultural-land ban. The on-disk sibling kbli-2025-real-estate-property-investment-bali-2026.mdx:119 already carries this correct version (internal-consistency anchor).
